arguments.command:
python -c "
from argparse import Namespace
import semver

# Test compare cases
test_cases = [
    ('1.0.0', '2.0.0', '-1'),  # v1 < v2
    ('2.0.0', '1.0.0', '1'),   # v1 > v2
    ('1.0.0', '1.0.0', '0'),   # v1 == v2
    ('1.0.0-alpha', '1.0.0', '-1'),  # pre-release < release
    ('1.0.0-rc.1', '1.0.0-beta.2', '1'),  # rc > beta
]

for v1, v2, expected in test_cases:
    args = Namespace(version1=v1, version2=v2)
    result = semver.cmd_compare(args)
    status = '✓' if result == expected else '✗'
    print(f'{status} cmd_compare({v1!r}, {v2!r}): {result} (expected {expected})')
"
